description.value: The Vic Downtown is an independent coffee roaster and cafe on the corner of 4th Avenue and Victoria Street in the heart of Kamloops, roasting small batches of globally sourced fair-trade and organic beans — including from a women's cooperative in Peru — in-house throughout the week. Beyond coffee, the shop offers a broad food menu spanning breakfast through afternoon snacks, plus over 65 varieties of loose-leaf tea available by the cup or to take home. A sunny street-corner patio makes it a natural gathering spot in the middle of downtown Kamloops.
